title: Simulacrum: AI Automation Builder (Ebonhawk fork)
description: Private fork of Simulacrum, narrowed to one job: turn natural-language ability text (monster statblocks, class features, magic items) into working dnd5e automations. The agent parses an ability, shows an editable preview of what it understood, builds the Feature with its activities, effects and midi-qol/DAE/CAT flags, then hands it to the GM to use in play while it records what happened. OpenRouter only. Not for public distribution.

requires.reason: The builder writes midi-qol flags (repeating saves) and the self-test drives the midi workflow to run the ability deterministically.
Conditions are applied through DAE changes (macro.StatusEffect); applied effects will not land without it.
Provides the workflow helpers the self-test uses and the event passes these automations are written against.

recommends.reason: Source of the patterns this builder follows; needed at run time by automations that reference its generics.
Referenced by automations that apply named effects rather than raw conditions.
